english.title: Cause a false alarm of fire to be given
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) knowingly caused to be given a false alarm of fire to **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..) a person acting on behalf of a fire and rescue authority
english.legislation: Contrary to section 49 f the Fire and Rescue Services Act 2004.

date and location

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required

english.notes:
(i) See also CJS Code FS04009 and H4695 - for knowingly give a false alarm of fire.
(ii) The prosecutor may apply to the court for an Anti-social Behaviour Order.

other.penalty:
Fifty one weeks imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale.

Until the commencement of section 281(5) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 the penalty will be - Three months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
